forever_changes.text: Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Humans can be Hunters, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials read from the BlizzCon demo: Will to Survive removes all Stuns on a 3 minute cooldown, Perception gives 20 seconds of stealth detection, Sword Specialization grants 2% spell and ability critical strike chance with a sword, and The Human Spirit grants 5% Spirit.
Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Humans can be Hunters, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials after Blizzard's 26 October notes: Will to Survive removes all Stuns on a 3 minute cooldown, Perception gives 20 seconds of stealth detection, Ruthless increases critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%, and The Human Spirit increases Spirit by 10%.

sources.label: Blizzard development notes, racial tuning (26 and 27 October 2026), reposted by MMO-Champion

forever_changes.text: Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Orcs can be Mages, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials read from the BlizzCon demo: Blood Fury grants 10% Attack Power and Spell Power for 15 seconds on a 2 minute cooldown, Shatter Curse removes and grants immunity to Curses and Banes and reduces magical damage taken 15% for 8 seconds, Axe Specialization grants 1% critical strike chance with an axe, and Hardiness reduces stun duration 20%.
Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Orcs can be Mages, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials after Blizzard's 26 and 27 October notes: Blood Fury increases Attack Power, Ranged Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 seconds on a 2 minute cooldown, Shatter Curse removes and grants immunity to Curses and Banes and reduces magical damage taken by 15% for 8 seconds, Command increases the damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets by 5%, and Hardiness reduces stun duration by 20%. Savage, the 1% critical strike passive that had replaced the axe bonus, is removed.

Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials read from the BlizzCon demo: War Stomp stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yards for 2 seconds on a 2 minute cooldown, Cultivation grows bonus herbs that need no Herbalism to gather, Plainsrunning raises movement speed the longer you keep moving, and Endurance grants 5% Health and 1% Hit chance.
Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials after Blizzard's 26 October notes: War Stomp stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yards for 2 seconds on a 2 minute cooldown, Cultivation grows bonus herbs that need no Herbalism to gather on a 15 minute cooldown, Plainsrunning raises movement speed by 2% a stack the longer you keep moving, up to 60%, and no longer raises mounted speed, and Endurance increases Health by 5%.

forever_changes.text: Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Trolls can be Warlocks, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials read from the BlizzCon demo: Berserking grants 10% casting and attack speed on a 3 minute cooldown, Rapid Regeneration channels back 50% of maximum Health, Beast Slaying grants 5% damage against Beasts, and Regeneration keeps 10% of Health regeneration running in combat. The Berserking duration is read as 10 seconds by one outlet and 12 by another.
Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Trolls can be Warlocks, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials after Blizzard's 27 October notes: Berserking increases casting and attack speed by 10% for 15 seconds on a 3 minute cooldown, Rapid Regeneration channels back 50% of maximum Health, Beast Slaying grants 5% damage against Beasts, and Regeneration keeps 10% of Health regeneration running in combat.

forever_changes.text: Skyborne is unlocked by the Skyborne Heroic Pack, reported at $29.99, rather than by a base subscription.

forever_changes.text: Skyborne characters begin on Zephras Isle, a starting zone covering levels 1 to 12.

forever_changes.text: Shaman is available to Skyborne only on the Horde and Mage only on the Alliance.

Racials shown in the BlizzCon demo: Walk on Air (glide downward for 10 seconds), Read Ley Line (100% health and mana regeneration for 15 seconds), Wind Blessed (1% haste), Elemental Insight (5% damage to Elementals). Skyborne choose Horde or Alliance at creation.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

One demo transcription reads a different second active for each faction: Alliance Skyborne get Read Ley Line, Horde Skyborne get Skysight, which grants 10% movement and mounted speed for 30 seconds or 15 minutes near a convergence of elements.
Skyborne is a neutral race: the player chooses Horde or Alliance at character creation.

bonuses.description: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 18.
Decreases the magical resistances of your spell targets by 10.
Decreases the threat generated by your spells by 15%.
Health or Mana gained from Drain Life and Drain Mana increased by 15%.
Your pet gains 15 stamina and 100 spell resistance against all schools of magic.
Mana cost of Shadow spells reduced by 15%.
-0.1 sec to the casting time of your Flash Heal spell.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 2%.
Increases your chance of a critical hit with Prayer of Healing by 25%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish ability by 30 sec.
Increases your maximum Energy by 10.
Heals the rogue for 500 when Vanish is performed.
Damage dealt by Thorns increased by 4 and duration increased by 50%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 2%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Tranquility and Hurricane spells by 50%.
The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.
After casting your Healing Wave or Lesser Healing Wave spell, gives you a 25% chance to gain Mana equal to 35% of the base cost of the spell.
Your Healing Wave will now jump to additional nearby targets. Each jump reduces the effectiveness of the heal by 80%, and the spell will jump to up to two additional targets.
Increases the range of your Mend Pet spell by 50% and the effect by 10%.  Also reduces the cost by 30%.
Increases your pet's stamina by 30 and all spell resistances by 40.
Increases the damage of Multi-shot and Volley by 15%.
Increases the chance of triggering a Judgement of Light heal by 10%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 1%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.
Gives the Paladin a chance on every melee hit to heal your party for 200.
Increases the block value of your shield by 30.
Gives you a 20% chance to generate an additional Rage point whenever damage is dealt to you.
Increases the threat generated by Sunder Armor by 15%.
